decisions.reason: The accelerator program for green startups is low-cost, still featured on the home page, and supports partnerships and the firm's image, though it sits outside the core machinery business.
The bio-based bitumen binder still has its own page and fits the circular-materials story, but its market traction is uncertain and it lies far from the core equipment business.
The WASTX Cleanic decontamination plant, developed with partner ERMAFA, is close to the core offer and is prominently promoted on the home page in both years, signaling active commercialization.
